senses.gloss: भाम m. 1. Brightness, splendour; 2. the sun; 3. passion, wrath, anger; 4. a sister’s husband.
भामा f. 1. A passionate woman; 2. name of one of the wives of Kṛṣṇa, more commonly called Satyabhāmā.
भामिनी f. 1. A handsome woman, R.viii.28; 2. a passionate woman, उपचीयत एव कापि शोभा परितो भामिनि ते मुखस्य नित्यम् Bh.V.ii.1.
